metric_metadata.formula: 0.35*S_alpha + 0.25*S_boundary + 0.15*S_selection + 0.25*mean(SSIM over declared composites); alpha_sad is normalized SAD
metric_metadata.boundary_tolerance: scaled max(1px, round(0.0015 * diagonal)) plus canonical 1px/2px/4px F1; symmetric matching
metric_metadata.roi: union(candidate/reference alpha bounding boxes), padded by 5% image diagonal
metric_metadata.color_space: linear-RGB metrics after declared sRGB decode
metric_metadata.resize_rule: no resize for canonical metrics; model geometry restores to source dimensions

alpha-sad.reason: normalized SAD = mean absolute alpha difference over all pixels

boundary-band-alpha.reason: alpha MAE, RMSE, normalized SAD, soft IoU and binary IoU(.1,.5,.9) restricted to the dilated reference boundary band

boundary-band-iou-01-05-09.reason: binary IoU at thresholds 0.1, 0.5 and 0.9 on the dilated reference boundary band

boundary-band-mae.reason: mean absolute alpha error on the dilated reference boundary band

boundary-band-rmse.reason: RMSE alpha error on the dilated reference boundary band

boundary-band-sad.reason: normalized SAD alpha error on the dilated reference boundary band

boundary-band-soft-iou.reason: sum(min(candidate,reference))/sum(max(candidate,reference)) on the dilated reference boundary band

boundary-f1-1px.reason: symmetric boundary F1 at one-pixel Chebyshev tolerance

boundary-f1-2px.reason: symmetric boundary F1 at two-pixel Chebyshev tolerance

boundary-f1-4px.reason: symmetric boundary F1 at four-pixel Chebyshev tolerance

boundary-f1-scaled.reason: symmetric boundary precision/recall F1 at max(1,round(0.0015*image diagonal)) pixels

composite-mae.reason: mean linear-RGB absolute composite error averaged over seven declared backgrounds

composite-psnr.reason: 10*log10(1/MSE), with actual linear-RGB MSE averaged over seven declared backgrounds

composite-ssim-full-roi.reason: deterministic sliding Gaussian 11x11 SSIM reported for full canvas and PhotoRoom ROI; ROI value enters agreement

connectivity.reason: mean topology similarity over thresholds 0.1 through 0.9

edge-colour.reason: linear-RGB candidate/reference colour absolute error on the reference boundary band

foreground-colour.reason: alpha-weighted linear-RGB foreground error excluding pixels where both alphas are effectively zero

fractional-alpha.reason: mean absolute alpha error where reference alpha is in (0.02,0.98)

gradient.reason: mean forward-neighbor alpha gradient magnitude difference

performance-provenance.reason: real candidates record cold start, warm median/p95, throughput, model bytes, RSS availability, provider and hardware; synthetic performance is explicitly optional

topology.reason: 1/(1+absolute 4-connected component plus hole disagreement) at alpha threshold 0.5

champions.reason: real scores unavailable; assisted SAM is separate and not run

gate.reason: No approved candidate completed real inference; promotion is unavailable.

artifact_scope: all Stage 1/2/3 candidates and swept Stage-3 survivors on tune records; frozen selected pipeline on validation records; unavailable real candidates status-only
